title: The New Flatmate · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: A: This is a small flat. It is in Beijing. Three people live here. Tom is a teacher. He is from Canada. Lily is a nurse. She is from China. Ben is a student. He is from Australia. Tom has a cat. It is white. The cat is in the living room. Lily has a plant. It is green. The plant is on the table. Ben has a bike. It is red. The bike is near the door.
